Frequently asked questions
A learning platform is a comprehensive digital solution that enables organizations to create, deliver, and manage training programs. The best learning platforms combine content management and creation, user engagement tools, and analytics to create meaningful learning experiences that drive business outcomes.
The Docebo Learning Platform is more than just an LMS. It incorporates elements of an LMS, LXP, authoring tool, content management, virtual classroom, performance support, analytics, and more.
The platform’s versatility, scalability, multi-audience capabilities, personalization, and advanced AI are also key differentiators.
Yes. To see the platform in action, you can take a tour or book a demo.
Migration is easy, with no downtime or data loss. The typical process includes:
- Scoping & Planning: Joint definition of scope and timeline aligned to your launch date.
- Data Migration (ETL): Extract, transform, and load your data into a sandbox environment for validation and UAT.
- Validation: Review and approve sandbox results.
- Cutover: Perform a final delta load and migrate to production on the agreed go-live date.
You’re supported every step of the way, with dedicated experts and support staff who make sure everything goes smoothly and you launch to high adoption.
Docebo provides comprehensive support throughout and beyond the implementation of its learning platform, ensuring a seamless transition and sustained success. We guide clients through a structured onboarding methodology, encompassing project kickoff, discovery, training, configuration, and testing phases. This approach facilitates effective migration, implementation, launch, and user adoption.
Post-launch, we offer various support services tailored to organizational needs, including global 24/7 assistance and specialized consulting for complex use cases. Clients also have access to additional self-help resources:
- Docebo Help Center, a comprehensive knowledge base.
- Docebo University, which offers on-demand courses and certifications to enhance platform proficiency.
- Docebo Community, which serves as a platform for networking, sharing best practices, and engaging with peers and experts.
This multifaceted support system ensures that organizations are well-equipped to achieve their learning objectives and drive long-term business impact. Learn more about our services.
To start, we offer all important learner engagement capabilities, including gamification, social learning, learner communities, online courses, quizzes, and more. But we go further and optimize learning for organizational goals. This includes: Integrations and automations to streamline your workflows and save time, data tools and dashboards to measure and improve your learning program, and the most innovative new technology, including Generative AI tools to create interactive and personalized learning content at scale.
Our content marketplace contains over 30,000 courses and professional certifications from the world’s best learning content providers. We have courses on in-demand skills from leadership to machine learning. If learners need it, there’s likely a course on it.
In addition to our robust catalog of elearning content, you can also generate high-quality interactive learning in seconds with Docebo Creator, our full AI content creation tool. And with AI learning content creation workflows, full learning plans can be built in seconds.
Docebo’s main tier costs $9/user, with a 250 user minimum and includes integrations, custom dashboards, automation, the ability to train multiple audiences, and much more.
For complex enterprises, pricing is custom. Learn more on our pricing page.
